reviews.text: The professionals were very available by phone and I was satisfied with the consultations for our cat. The price was reasonable.

Thank you to Dr. Leloup for the excellent care he provided for my little Maltese, for his ultrasound and X-ray examinations, his treatments, and for his consultations where time seemed to stand still and the discussions were so precise. Thank you for your kindness and support until the very last day, the most heartbreaking day, the one we couldn't have entrusted to anyone else. Thank you for all these years of helping us ease Naxos's heart condition. Thank you so much, Doctor.

I really didn't appreciate them taking my cat by the carrier without my consent to have his claws trimmed in a room and telling me not to come with him, especially since my cat didn't know either the vet or the assistant in question. I found that a very harsh way of doing things. I've always accompanied my cat because it reassures him to have someone he knows. ❤️‍🩹

A friend whose terminally ill dog, being treated at this clinic, was politely turned away this afternoon... She wanted her dog euthanized, but the vet, being too busy with emergencies, told her to come in on Monday.

And if the dog's condition worsens, she should call VetAdom... For me, an owner requesting euthanasia for her pet is an emergency. If she requests it, it's so her dog doesn't suffer.

But at this clinic, animal welfare seems to be secondary... My friend didn't even dare insist for fear of angering the vet, and she didn't want her dog to die at a difficult time. So she's keeping her dog until Monday. Euthanasia is not a trivial matter; it's the end of a story between a human and their animal, the last act of love one can offer them when nothing more is medically possible, to avoid unnecessary suffering. They know about this little dog's health.

Vaccinations are probably more profitable on a Saturday afternoon...

I was shocked.
Great clinic :)
A warm welcome from a team attentive to our four-legged friends and their owners. Always with a smile ☺️
Excellent service!
Very welcoming reception

Thank you, Dr. Stylianidis and your team.

Your condolences on the passing of my cat Clovis are deeply touching.
Ms. Perez

Super friendly team, always finds a slot for emergencies, very professional.
I recommend them.

A huge thank you to Dr. Jerusalem and Dr. Vanneph, who respectively cared for my cat during his appointments and his final moments. And also to Dr. Leloup, who enabled him to live three and a half years longer thanks to two major surgeries. All three were incredibly helpful. The clinic staff are also very kind. I highly recommend them.

Until now, we had a good opinion of this veterinary clinic. Unfortunately, our last visit drastically changed our perception.

Due to a miscommunication regarding the appointment time—I had written down 6:30 p.m., while they had scheduled it for 6:00 p.m.—I received a call at 6:09 p.m. to check on my status. I explained that I had written down 6:30 p.m., but that there was no problem, I was only 10 minutes away and would be there right away. I was then curtly told not to come, as they wouldn't see me.

Despite this, I decided to go anyway and arrived at 6:19 p.m. I tried to explain that it was a scheduling emergency, due to an imminent departure, and that I had no other option. The veterinarian showed no understanding or empathy. She simply told me there were other veterinarians in the area.

I pointed out that at this hour, there was very little chance of finding one available immediately. It was no use. I even suggested waiting until she finished her current appointments, given the urgency of the situation, but she categorically refused.

It's truly regrettable that a practice with which we had established a relationship couldn't demonstrate even a modicum of flexibility and compassion in such a situation.

WARNING. Read this before any surgery: following this botched operation, our Somali cat's condition worsened dramatically, with stomach perforation and other serious problems, forcing us to euthanize him. First Opinion: We had our cat operated on there for a cystotomy.

Up until now, all our cats (3) have been well cared for, but never for surgery. They aren't very well equipped (they can't perform certain operations like urethrostomy, see below). Dr. Le.....p, who has always been very kind, told us that they had successfully removed all the bladder stones, but not the two or three that remained in the urethra, much to my surprise... but that, according to her, this wouldn't prevent urination! (completely illogical). It's like unclogging your sink drain but not removing the blockage in the pipe... it's pointless, the blockage is guaranteed to reappear... and look at the result.
Upon his discharge on Saturday, rushed due to Christmas Eve and the weekend getaway, with Sunday and Monday being holidays, our cat wasn't urinating and was starting to position himself in all sorts of places. in the house, and he ended up bleeding... during the night. In the morning, after my son had managed to sleep for two hours, exhausted, the poor cat was completely lethargic and weak. We had to call the emergency vet to rehydrate him; his pulse was 90 (40 normal) and his creatinine was 56 (15/20 normal). The vet told us to take him urgently to the Arcueil clinic, as he was at risk of dying from a blocked kidney and self-poisoning.

I'll spare you the details, but they first stabilized him for three days (cost €1200), then they found fluid in his abdomen, two internal ventral stitches that had come undone, and a hematoma in his bladder (that's a lot!), plus the stones blocked in his urethra (the vet saw it immediately by inserting a catheter which It's stuck at 2cm...) They offered to operate again.

Cost €2500 in addition to the €1200, making €3700 in total.

I called Dr. St...XXX..XXX, the manager of the clinic, to ask her to take our cat back and operate on him to reduce the costs and cover them (F....s is very professional but the prices are exorbitant, due to the urgency and limited resources). She coldly replied that they weren't able to operate on him, let alone keep him afterward, and that in case of a urethrostomy, they weren't equipped to perform it, and that they had no one available at night, even though they kept him for three days and nights (he was therefore left alone with the risk of death, kidney failure), and that our cat had been suffering since Saturday, December 23rd, and so had we! No consideration whatsoever.
She told me, "WE'LL TAKE IT." "€1850 AT OUR EXPENSE" is all we can do, very bluntly and without any empathy. She therefore acknowledged their responsibility.

We were able to negotiate with F...is to reduce the bill from €3700 to approximately €2500, which was done.

I then asked her to take full responsibility. She replied that she couldn't make a decision as the manager, and then finally that SHE WOULDN'T TAKE ANY RESPONSIBILITY!!! I then asked her to at least honor her commitments and pay the promised €1850.
We then tried to make an appointment with them to resolve this amicably, following the advice of the professional body and our lawyer, but they ultimately passed the buck to their insurer.
So they are not honoring their commitment, but it doesn't matter; their responsibility has been acknowledged by the insurance company's expert. Our cat is recovering from his two successive surgeries; he is saved. Note that they haven't contacted him since Saturday, December 23, 2017—quite shocking!

Avoid this clinic where there is absolutely no empathy for your pet or for you. As soon as there's a problem, you're left to fend for yourself and to F....

(A huge thank you to them for saving him!) Shame on this vet; they're a money-making machine!!!
Very friendly staff and top-notch vets!

I'm taking a moment to share my opinion about this veterinary clinic. I've been bringing my pets in for checkups for over 10 years. The Covid pandemic and lockdowns were difficult times, but despite everything, the entire team was dedicated to doing their best to ensure consultations never stopped. These are moments I will never forget. I have a cat who needs monthly checkups. And getting back to today, the service is still excellent. Each veterinarian takes the time for each of their patients. Thank you to them all. They have my utmost admiration and respect. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic where kindness and patience abound. 😻🌴

For many years now, all our cats have been treated at this clinic.

The entire team demonstrates compassion, love for animals, and gentleness. I trust them completely for every cat who has shared my life.
In my previous review, I forgot to give a special mention to the nurses, who were also top-notch! Oversight corrected.

Effective without extra cost or unnecessary expense, but above all my cat no longer has any symptoms - I went without an appointment at 9am after a terrible night watching my cat try to regurgitate something and I saw a vet right away.

I really liked this clinic over four years ago now. Then I brought my cat in because he wasn't eating and would hide for weeks on end. After countless tests, blood work, and other procedures, nothing conclusive came of it. Dr. Leloup, whom I was very fond of, told me he had cat flu (feline herpesvirus) that needed to be treated before trying cortisone. I'll post photos of his eye so you can see for yourselves. He was hospitalized by his rescue vet for ten days before being discharged. He didn't have cat flu at all, far from it, but a tumor behind his eye. His days were numbered, and I think the photos I'll add speak for themselves. Cat flu? I'm afraid to take my cats to the vet unnecessarily after that bad experience, so they stay nice and warm at home. Best of luck.
Excellent clinic, the vets and nurses are lovely!
My vets for several years now, for many families with exotic pets such as rats, guinea pigs, and rabbits. I recommend this clinic without hesitation.
Our favorite clinic!!!
Excellent, competent and friendly veterinarians!

They have absolutely no respect; they take matters into their own hands without your consent and only make the situation worse. My cat was perfectly fine until he ended up in their care, which ultimately led to his death!

Very unpleasant, and when you ask a question, she's condescending.

Other veterinarians in the area are much more competent and less expensive.

If it were possible to give zero stars, I would. I brought my cat in for routine checkups, and the vet took it upon herself to do things differently without discussing it with me beforehand, and therefore without my consent. This resulted in my cat's death, even though he was otherwise healthy.

Avoid at all costs!

Avoid at all costs!! False diagnoses and far too many unnecessary additional tests, according to my new vet! Exorbitant prices and a rip-off… My cat, who had a thyroid problem, was labeled "aggressive" and told he needed to be anesthetized for blood tests (which were also unnecessary). He underwent numerous pointless tests… So I changed vets, and they didn't even give him the correct file… a complete lack of professionalism!
Very accommodating and efficient!
Still very satisfied with both the vets and the assistants.

My cat is very timid and doesn't let anyone do anything to him. But as soon as he's in Dr. Stylianidis's hands, he's transformed thanks to her professionalism. He lets her get his vaccinations, trim his nails without any problem, etc. I'm almost jealous because I wish it were so easy at home!
Very friendly staff. However, a bit pricey.
They are very competent, and the prices are really low for Paris.
This is the clinic I've been taking my dog ​​to since he was a puppy. I've always been treated with such kindness, both on the phone and in person. …
